meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: 自媒体创作者需要在X(Twitter)发布内容时，支持图文、视频、引用推文及Markdown长文发布，通过真实Chrome浏览器绕过反自动化检测，一键完成多格式内容分发，有效规避封号风险。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键把图文视频和长文发布到X，规避封号风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常把图文视频同步到X，担心频繁操作被限流封号。
copy.tagline_en: Publish images, videos and long posts to X in one click, avoiding account bans.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly publish images, videos or long text to X and worry about being flagged or banned.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用真实 Chrome 浏览器把内容发到 X（Twitter）：文字配图、视频、引用推文和 Markdown 长文。默认只做预览，加 --submit 才真正发布。
howto.when: 当你要把图文、视频、引用推文等内容发到 X（Twitter）时它会接管；Markdown 长文文章也可发。首次运行需在真实 Chrome 中手动登录一次。

say.text: 把「Hello!」这条推文发到 X，配图 ./photo.png，先预览
say.note: 默认只预览，不会真的发出

say.text: 用 ./article.md 发一篇 X 长文，封面用 ./cover.jpg
引用一条推文链接，加评论「说得好」后发布

howto.what_en: Claude posts to X (Twitter) through a real Chrome browser: text with images, video, quote tweets, and Markdown long-form articles. It previews by default; you add --submit to actually publish.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to publish image/text posts, videos, quote tweets, and similar content to X, including Markdown articles. First run needs a manual X login in Chrome.

say_en.text: Post "Hello!" to X with ./photo.png — preview it first
Publish ./article.md as an X long-form article with ./cover.jpg
say_en.note: Needs X Premium; previews by default

say_en.text: Quote a tweet link and add the comment "Nice one", then publish
